1. Update index.html: Replace existing favicon links with <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="/icon2.png"> and <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/icon2.png">. Keep manifest.

3. In src/App.tsx, src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx, src/pages/TermsOfService.tsx: Replace all instances of text logo "tyler.ag" in .nav-logo (both Link and span) with <img src="/icon2.png" alt="Tyler.ag" />, keeping Link where it was, change footer spans to Links to home.
4. Update src/App.css: Modify .nav-logo styles to accommodate image (display:flex;align-items:center;text-decoration:none; remove font props). Add .nav-logo img {height:2.25rem;width:auto; transition...} and .footer .nav-logo img {height:1.5rem;}. Add hover effect: logo scale 1.05.
5. To make attractive for new customers: Enhance visual appeal - add subtle animations (fade-in on scroll? or CSS trans), modernize color scheme (keep purple accent or suggest teal/blue for trust/professional AI), improve hero with better glow/orb matching logo, ensure perfect mobile resp (test mentally). Add box-shadow to nav on hover or something. Output final edited files via tools, verify responsive.
Use read_file, edit_file, write_file, bash for preview if needed. Explain changes.
